resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1958 newspaper item names Pacific Light and Power Co. as the donor; the photo caption credits Portland General Electric Co. with the steel. Both are kept in the story and the donor is not stated as settled.

notes_for_editor: Built 1958 and abandoned are supported by firelookout.com and the Oregon Lookouts page. Staffing is a 1958 plan, not confirmed use. Location is unconfirmed: firelookout.com says not determined, and WillhiteWeb calls its spot a best guess. The record coordinate (45.59377, -122.81182) is unverified and should not be shown as the lookout site without that caveat. The WillhiteWeb access rating ('Likely easy') is an unconfirmed guess; the story does not repeat it as fact and says no source confirms whether the spot can be reached. The WillhiteWeb page is a lookout-history web page (WillhiteWeb.com), not an official record, and the story describes it that way. Donor disagreement is noted, not resolved.
